sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
முந்தை வினைப் பயனோ முகுந்தன் மருகா
கந்தா என்றவுடன் வந்து நிற்பாயே இதுவும்
sections.translit:
mundhai vinaip payanO mukundhan marugA
kandhA endRavudan vandhu niRpAyE idhuvum
sections.en: Oh Lord Vishnu’s nephew Skandha, is this because of my past evil deeds that you are not here now, when I need you? Usually, you come and stand the moment I call out your name.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
மாதமும் மலையேறி மயிலம் வந்து நிற்பேன்
காதமும் கணக்கிட்டுச் சோர்ந்து விட்டாயோ
sections.translit:
mAdhamum malaiyERi mayilam vandhu niRpEn
kAdhamum kaNakkittuch chOrndhu vittAyO
sections.en: Each month on the day of Krithigai, I used to climb the hill and stand in your abode, Mailam. Did you calculate the distance of my present residence and get exhausted, choosing not to appear?

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
அழும்போது வாராத காரணம் என்னவோ
விழும்போது கரம் தந்து உதவாதது விவேகமோ
மாயை புரிய தருணமிது மகேசன் தனயா
சேயை மீட்டிடவே ஓடிவா சிகி வாஹனா
sections.translit:
azhumpOdhu vArAdha kAraNam ennavO
vizhumpOdhu karam thandhu udhavAdhadhu vivEgamO
mAyai puriya tharuNamidhu magEsan thanayA
sEyai mIttidavE OdivA sikhi vAhanA
sections.en: What is the reason for not coming when I was crying? Is it prudent to not lend a helping hand when I was falling? This is the opportune moment,  Maheswara’s son, to demonstrate your real power by performing an illusion or magic. Lord who rides on the peacock, Muruga, please hasten to redeem this child in dire circumstances.

notes: Reference is made in Anupallavi to the sacred Mailam shrine of Lord Muruga which the author used to visit each Krithigai during his adolescent years to take darshan of the Lord. Lord Muruga granted the wishes of the demon Soorapadman prior to his death, asking him to do penance as a peacock near the mountain in this area, 15 kilometers from Tindivanam. The details of the sthalam and the origin of the Mailam name13 appear in the legend of this Kshetram. Mailam shrine of Lord Muruga
